#!/usr/bin/env bash

set -e

install_packages() {
  echo "Installing packages..."

  local packages="$1"
  read -ra packages <<<"$packages"

  # Check that it is not empty
  if [ ${#packages[@]} -eq 0 ]; then
    return
  fi
  apt-get update

  for package in "${packages[@]}"; do
    pkg="$package"

    if dpkg -s "$pkg" &>/dev/null; then
      echo "Package $pkg already installed!"
      continue
    fi

    if ! apt-cache show "$pkg" &>/dev/null; then
      echo "Package $pkg not found! :("
      continue
    fi

    echo "Installing package $pkg..."
    if ! apt-get -y install "$pkg" &>/dev/null; then
      echo "Could not install $pkg"
      exit 1
    fi
  done
}

# Install additional packages if specified
if [[ -n "$PAPERLESS_CUSTOM_PACKAGES" ]]; then
  install_packages "$PAPERLESS_CUSTOM_PACKAGES"
fi

exec "/init"

#!/usr/bin/env bash

DOCUMENT_FILE_NAME=${1}

echo "
Document ${DOCUMENT_ID} is about to be consumed.
"

IN="$DOCUMENT_FILE_NAME"
OUT="${DOCUMENT_FILE_NAME}_tmp"
PAGES=$(pdfinfo "$IN" | grep ^Pages: | tr -dc '0-9')
echo "Starting to remove blank pages from $IN"
non_blank() {
    for i in $(seq 1 $PAGES)
    do
        if [ $(convert -density 25 "$IN[$((i-1))]" -define histogram:unique-colors=true -format %c histogram:info:- | wc -l) -gt 100 ]
        then
            echo $i
            #echo $i 1>&2
        fi
        echo -n . 1>&2
    done | tee out.tmp
    echo 1>&2
}

set +x
pdftk "$IN" cat $(non_blank) output "$OUT"
rm out.tmp
mv "$OUT" "$IN"
echo "finishing removing blank pages from $IN"

#!/bin/sh
shrink ()
{
        gs                                      \
          -q -dNOPAUSE -dBATCH -dSAFER          \
          -sDEVICE=pdfwrite                     \
          -dCompatibilityLevel=1.3              \
          -dPDFSETTINGS=/screen                 \
          -dEmbedAllFonts=true                  \
          -dSubsetFonts=true                    \
          -dAutoRotatePages=/None               \
          -dColorImageDownsampleType=/Bicubic   \
          -dColorImageResolution=$3             \
          -dGrayImageDownsampleType=/Bicubic    \
          -dGrayImageResolution=$3              \
          -dMonoImageDownsampleType=/Subsample  \
          -dMonoImageResolution=$3              \
          -sOutputFile="$2"                     \
          "$1"
}

check_smaller ()
{
        # If $1 and $2 are regular files, we can compare file sizes to
        # see if we succeeded in shrinking. If not, we copy $1 over $2:
        if [ ! -f "$1" -o ! -f "$2" ]; then
                return 0;
        fi
        ISIZE="$(echo $(wc -c "$1") | cut -f1 -d\ )"
        OSIZE="$(echo $(wc -c "$2") | cut -f1 -d\ )"
        if [ "$ISIZE" -lt "$OSIZE" ]; then
                echo "Input smaller than output, doing straight copy" >&2
                cp "$1" "$2"
        fi
}

usage ()
{
        echo "Reduces PDF filesize by lossy recompressing with Ghostscript."
        echo "Not guaranteed to succeed, but usually works."
        echo "  Usage: $1 infile [outfile] [resolution_in_dpi]"
}

IFILE="$1"

# Need an input file:
if [ -z "$IFILE" ]; then
        usage "$0"
        exit 1
fi

# Output filename defaults to "-" (stdout) unless given:
if [ ! -z "$2" ]; then
        OFILE="$2"
else
        OFILE="-"
fi

# Output resolution defaults to 72 unless given:
if [ ! -z "$3" ]; then
        res="$3"
else
        res="72"
fi

shrink "$IFILE" "$OFILE" "$res" || exit $?

check_smaller "$IFILE" "$OFILE"

set -e
cp /etc/flexget-config/config.yml /config/config.yml
# deluge generates the daemon password on its own first
# start; on a cold cluster flexget can get here first.
until [ -s /rpc/password ]; do
  echo "waiting for deluge to generate the daemon password"
  sleep 5
done
printf 'deluge:\n  password: "%s"\n' "$(cat /rpc/password)" \
  > /config/variables.yml

variables: /config/variables.yml

web_server:
  bind: 0.0.0.0
  port: 5050
  web_ui: yes

templates:
  nyaa:
    rss:
      # Literature → English-translated. Change the `c`
      # parameter to follow a different category.
      url: https://nyaa.si/?page=rss&q=dandadan&c=0_0&f=0
    deluge:
      host: deluge-daemon
      port: 58846
      username: flexget
      password: '{? deluge.password ?}'
      path: /downloads/manga

tasks:
  dandadan:
    rss: "https://nyaa.si/?page=rss&q=dandadan&c=0_0&f=0"
    regexp:
      accept:
        - '(?i)^Dandadan \d+(\s*\(\d{4}\))?'
    series:
      - dandadan:
          identified_by: sequence
          begin: 100
    deluge:
      host: deluge-daemon
      port: 58846
      username: flexget
      password: '{? deluge.password ?}'
      path: /downloads/manga/dandadan/
  manga:
    template: nyaa
    regexp:
      accept:
        - '(?!)'
      reject:
        - '(?i)\b(raw|jpn|chinese|spanish)\b'

schedules:
  - tasks: [manga,dandadan]
    interval:
      minutes: 30

set -e
# The daemon password is generated once, here, and kept on
# a volume flexget also mounts. Nothing has to put it in
# git, and nothing has to be typed in by hand.
if [ ! -s /rpc/password ]; then
  head -c16 /dev/urandom | od -An -tx1 | tr -d ' \n' \
    > /rpc/password
  chmod 0640 /rpc/password
fi
# On a fresh volume deluge has not written auth yet, and a
# file holding only our user would leave deluge-web unable
# to reach its own daemon.
if [ ! -f /config/auth ]; then
  printf 'localclient:%s:10\n' \
    "$(head -c16 /dev/urandom | od -An -tx1 | tr -d ' \n')" \
    > /config/auth
fi
sed -i '/^flexget:/d' /config/auth
printf 'flexget:%s:10\n' "$(cat /rpc/password)" >> /config/auth
if [ -f /config/core.conf ]; then
  sed -i 's/"allow_remote": false/"allow_remote": true/' /config/core.conf
else
  printf '{\n  "file": 1,\n  "format": 1\n}{\n  "allow_remote": true,\n  "download_location": "/downloads"\n}\n' \
    > /config/core.conf
fi
chown 1000:1000 /config/auth /config/core.conf /rpc/password
